title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Job-Site Delivery and Pickup Rates
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental job-site delivery is offered by equipment class at the rates below.

| Equipment class | Delivery offered | Base delivery charge, USD | Charge per mile of one-way distance, USD | Largest one-way distance served, miles | Pickup charge, percent of the delivery charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | yes | 79.00 | 2.50 | 25 | 100 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | yes | 99.00 | 3.00 | 40 | 100 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | yes | 149.00 | 4.00 | 50 | 100 |

The distance is the one-way distance from the store to the job site. In the three classes where delivery is not offered every rate shows zero.

## Hypothetical rate reading

| Class | One-way distance | Delivery charge | Pickup charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 10 miles | 79.00 plus 10 miles at 2.50, that is 104.00 | 100 percent of 104.00, that is 104.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 40 miles | 99.00 plus 40 miles at 3.00, that is 219.00 | 219.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 51 miles | beyond the 50-mile limit; not served | none |

The distances are illustrative inputs only.
